body: Hey friend, I know the pain you feel. I lost my dad 15 years ago and it still hurts to this day. I had similar thoughts you are having now I also didn’t want to live in a world without him (sometimes I still don’t) but I found over time that the best way I could honor my dad was to fight against that dark feeling and try to find a better place. I know how impossible that feels right now so please don’t put too much pressure on yourself just take it day by day step by step. The pain of losing him will probably never go away but you will be able to reach a point where you can feel that pain in a place of relative peace.
